title: The AI infrastructure trade is still not over, says this top-performing fund manager. Where he’s investing.
summary: A BNY Mellon fund manager argues that AI infrastructure investment opportunities remain substantial despite some investors believing the trend has peaked. Campbell identifies overlooked sectors within the AI infrastructure space where investors can still capitalize on growth.
content: BNY Mellon Global Infrastructure Income exchange-traded fund manager Brock Campbell said some investors mistakenly believe the artificial-intelligence play has peaked. He flags what’s been overlooked.

zh.title: AI基础设施交易远未落幕，这位表现优异的基金经理这样说。他的投资去向
zh.summary: 美国银行纽约梅隆公司的一位基金经理辩称，尽管一些投资者认为这一趋势已经见顶，但AI基础设施投资机会仍然巨大。坎贝尔确认了AI基础设施领域内被忽视的部分，投资者仍可以在这些领域中获得增长机会。

title: Concerns county will not benefit from £2 bus cap
summary: A local councillor expresses concerns that bus operators have not committed to a £2 fare cap, raising questions about whether the county will actually benefit from the policy. The commitment from major operators is essential for the cap's intended effect on public transportation costs.
content: Councillor Justine Peberdy says Yeomans Travel and Sargeants Brothers have not committed to the cap.

zh.title: 担忧郡将无法从2英镑公交票价上限中获益
zh.summary: 一位地方议员对公交运营商未承诺执行2英镑票价上限表示担忧，这引发了关于该郡是否真正能从该政策中获益的问题。主要运营商的承诺对于票价上限对公共交通成本的预期效果至关重要。

title: Off sick? You need to phone your boss, back-to-work adviser says
summary: A back-to-work adviser recommends that sick employees call their employers rather than using text or email, citing research that direct communication reduces disengagement. This approach could help workers return faster and maintain workplace connections while recovering.
content: Relying on text and email means sick workers disengaged and were less likely to work again, says Sir Charlie Mayfield.

zh.title: 请病假？回到工作岗位的顾问说你需要给老板打电话
zh.summary: 一位帮助员工回归工作的顾问建议患病员工给雇主打电话，而不是使用文字或电子邮件，引用的研究表明直接沟通能减少工作脱离感。这种方法可以帮助工人更快地恢复工作并在恢复期间保持与工作场所的联系。

title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for ‘energy ceasefire’, calls for trilateral meeting with Putin, Trump
summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has indicated Ukraine's willingness to negotiate an "energy ceasefire" with Russia, contingent on Russia halting attacks on energy infrastructure. Zelenskyy is calling for a trilateral meeting involving Putin and Trump to facilitate these negotiations.
content: Zelenskyy said Ukraine is ready for an “energy ceasefire” with Russia, provided Moscow stops attacks on critical infrastructure.

zh.title: 泽连斯基表示乌克兰准备好进行"能源停火"，呼吁召开与普京、特朗普的三方会议
zh.summary: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示乌克兰愿意与俄罗斯谈判"能源停火"，但前提是俄罗斯停止对能源基础设施的攻击。泽连斯基呼吁召开涉及普京和特朗普的三方会议，以促进这些谈判。

title: ‘I don’t begrudge them their money’: My husband and I have friends who spend, spend, spend. How do we keep up?
summary: A couple seeks advice on navigating friendships with wealthy acquaintances who spend lavishly on leisure activities and travel. The financial disparity in social activities creates pressure and questions about maintaining relationships across different spending levels.
content: “A weekend away isn’t a weekend away. It’s a luxury hotel, expensive meals and a last-minute upgrade.”

zh.title: "我不嫉妒他们的钱"：我丈夫和我有朋友不停地花钱。我们如何跟上？
zh.summary: 一对夫妇寻求建议，如何与富有的熟人保持友谊，这些熟人在休闲活动和旅行上花费巨大。社交活动中的经济差异造成了压力，并引发了关于跨越不同消费水平维持关系的问题。

title: I made extra cash in 30 minutes by selling broken gold and silver jewelry — here’s how I did it
summary: CNBC tested The Alloy Market, an online platform for selling broken gold and precious metal jewelry, detailing the process and results. The platform offers a quick way to convert unused precious metal jewelry into cash.
content: CNBC Select tests The Alloy Market, an online gold and precious metal buyer. Here's how it went.

title: Texas turning blue may hinge on Democrats harnessing data center opposition
summary: Opposition to new data center development is becoming a defining issue in Texas's 2026 political races as voters worry about power consumption, water usage, and rising utility costs. Democrats may gain political advantage by mobilizing opposition to these projects.
content: Data center opposition is reshaping Texas' 2026 governor and Senate races as voters raise concerns over power, water and utility costs.

zh.title: 德州转蓝可能取决于民主党如何利用反对数据中心的声音
zh.summary: 对新数据中心开发的反对正在成为德州2026年政治竞选的决定性议题，因为选民担心电力消耗、用水量和公用事业成本上升。民主党可能通过动员反对这些项目的力量来获得政治优势。

title: UK economy will grow by less than expected next year, OECD says
summary: The OECD is forecasting lower-than-expected economic growth for the UK next year, driven by elevated energy prices stemming from Middle East conflicts and climate-related factors. These external pressures are expected to constrain British economic expansion.
content: Higher energy prices due to the conflict in the Middle East and climate change could hit growth.

zh.title: 经合组织称英国经济明年增长低于预期
zh.summary: 经合组织预测英国明年经济增长将低于预期，这是由中东冲突和气候相关因素引发的高能源价格所推动的。这些外部压力预计将制约英国经济增长。

title: AI drone maker hits $6.4 billion valuation as Ukraine war spurs defense tech
summary: Tekever, an AI-powered drone manufacturer, has reached a $6.4 billion valuation as European defense technology companies capitalize on increased military spending amid regional tensions. The company is part of a broader trend of defense tech startups securing significant funding.
content: Tekever is one of a number of European defense tech startups raising sizable rounds amid a rearmament campaign from countries in the region.

zh.title: 乌克兰战争刺激国防技术，AI无人机制造商估值达64亿美元

title: Why analysts say a diesel export ban could backfire
summary: Analysts warn that a ban on U.S. diesel exports could prove counterproductive by simultaneously reducing global diesel supply while driving prices higher. The policy could have unintended economic consequences both domestically and internationally.
content: A ban on U.S. diesel exports could reduce supplies and simultaneously lead to prices rising further, according to analysts.

zh.title: 为什么分析师说柴油出口禁令可能适得其反
zh.summary: 分析师警告称，禁止美国柴油出口可能会适得其反，因为它会同时减少全球柴油供应并推高价格。该政策可能会在国内外产生意想不到的经济后果。

title: Here are the hidden flaws in Warsh’s new way of tracking inflation
summary: Nomura economists challenge Kevin Warsh's alternative inflation tracking method, arguing it lacks superior predictive accuracy compared to established core inflation measures. The analysis questions whether the new approach offers meaningful improvements for policymakers.
content: Economists at Nomura say the new way Kevin Warsh is tracking inflation doesn’t have better predictive power than core readings.

zh.title: 沃什新型通胀追踪方法中的隐藏缺陷
zh.summary: 野村经济学家质疑凯文·沃什的替代通胀追踪方法，辩称与既定的核心通胀措施相比，它缺乏优越的预测精度。该分析质疑新方法是否能为政策制定者提供有意义的改进。

title: South Korea pushes for Trump summit with renegade North Korea, seeing opportunity for peace
summary: South Korea is advocating for a summit between President Trump and North Korea, viewing the current political environment as a potential opening for diplomatic negotiations. The initiative reflects Seoul's continued efforts to reduce tensions on the Korean peninsula.
content: South Korea pushes for Trump summit with renegade North Korea, seeing opportunity for peace

title: My friend grosses $300,000 a year with her pet-sitting business. She pays herself $50,000. Should I do the same?
summary: An entrepreneur seeks guidance on a pet-sitting business model where the owner grosses $300,000 annually but takes only $50,000 in personal income through a contractor-based structure. The question explores the viability and strategy of scaling a service business through independent contractors.
content: “She currently has about 15 sitters, all independent contractors.”

zh.title: 我的朋友通过宠物看护业务每年营收30万美元,但她只给自己支付5万美元。我应该这样做吗?
zh.summary: 一位企业家寻求关于宠物看护业务模式的指导,该模式中业主年营收为30万美元,但通过承包商结构只获得5万美元的个人收入。这个问题探讨了通过独立承包商扩展服务业务的可行性和策略。

title: Trump-Xi summit puts AI safety talks on the table but neither side wants to slow down
summary: A Trump-Xi summit will include discussions on AI safety, though both the U.S. and China show limited interest in slowing their respective AI development efforts. Despite growing safety concerns, the competitive pressure between superpowers appears to be prioritized over regulatory caution.
content: Recent weeks have seen AI safety fears reach new heights. That will be a key focus for the U.S. and Chinese premiers, analysts told CNBC.

zh.title: 特朗普-习近平峰会将人工智能安全谈判列入议程,但双方都不想放慢速度
zh.summary: 特朗普-习近平峰会将包括关于人工智能安全的讨论,尽管美国和中国都对减缓各自的人工智能发展努力兴趣有限。尽管安全问题日益突出,但超级大国之间的竞争压力似乎被优先考虑,而不是监管谨慎。

title: Iran says Trump’s threats a sign of ‘strategic desperation,’ floats conditions for Hormuz reopening
summary: Iran has characterized Trump's threats as signs of strategic desperation and offered conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz to international shipping. Tehran's diplomatic overture could potentially ease regional tensions and restore critical global shipping routes.
content: Tehran's proposal could pave the way for restoring traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, reviving fragile hopes for a diplomatic off-ramp.

zh.title: 伊朗称特朗普的威胁是"战略绝望"的表现,提出霍尔木兹海峡重新开放的条件
zh.summary: 伊朗将特朗普的威胁描述为战略绝望的迹象,并提出了霍尔木兹海峡重新向国际航运开放的条件。德黑兰的外交示好可能会缓解地区紧张局势并恢复关键的全球航运路线。

title: Will Trump's AI rebrand to 'super intelligence' catch on?
summary: Trump administration officials are testing the term 'super intelligence' as a rebrand for artificial intelligence. However, experts believe this terminology is unlikely to gain widespread adoption in the industry or media.
content: Some people close to the president have started to use the term but experts say it is unlikely to catch on.

title: South Korean solar stocks jump as curbs on Chinese sector expected to remain in place
summary: South Korean solar companies saw stock gains as U.S. trade restrictions on Chinese solar products remained in effect ahead of negotiations between the Trump and Xi administrations. The trade measures continue to benefit South Korean competitors in the market.

content: The Nasdaq Composite rose to a new all-time intraday high and closed at a record on Tuesday.

summary: Oil prices declined Wednesday following extended diplomatic talks between U.S. and Iranian officials at the United Nations. The discussions raised hopes for a potential peaceful resolution to Middle East tensions.
content: Oil fell Wednesday, amid hopes of a diplomatic solution to the conflict in the Middle East after Iran and the U.S. had talks.
